title: Contrasts: although, though, even though, in spite of, despite
summary: Как выразить уступку и контраст: although / though / even though, in spite of / despite, whereas / while, even if, конструкции вроде Tired as he was и however hard.
ru:
## although, though, even though: после них — предложение
Все три союза значат «хотя», и после них стоит **полное предложение** (подлежащее + глагол).
> **Although** the exam was difficult, most students passed. — Хотя экзамен был сложным, большинство сдало.
> **Though** it was late, we decided to walk. — Хоть и было поздно, мы решили пройтись.
- **although** — нейтральный и чуть более формальный;
- **though** — разговорнее; **even though** — сильнее, подчёркивает неожиданность факта: *She still smiled, **even though** she was in pain.*
- ~~Although he was ill, but he went to work.~~ → в английском **не нужно** второго союза «но»: Although he was ill, he went to work.

## though в конце фразы
Только **though** (не although) может стоять **в конце** предложения как наречие со значением «впрочем, правда»:
> The flat is small. I like it, **though**. — Квартира маленькая. Но мне она нравится.

## in spite of и despite: после них — существительное или -ing
**In spite of** и **despite** значат то же, что although, но за ними идёт **существительное, местоимение или герундий**, а не предложение.
> **Despite** the traffic, we arrived on time. — Несмотря на пробки, мы приехали вовремя.
> She kept working **in spite of** feeling exhausted. — Она продолжала работать, хотя чувствовала себя вымотанной.
Чтобы поставить после них предложение, добавляют **the fact that**: *Despite **the fact that** he had no experience, he got the job.*
- ~~Despite of the delay~~ → **Despite** the delay / **In spite of** the delay
- ~~In spite the rain~~ → In spite **of** the rain
- ~~Despite he was tired~~ → Despite **being** tired / Despite **the fact that** he was tired

## Контраст между двумя фактами: while, whereas
**While** и **whereas** противопоставляют два факта, не обязательно «вопреки». **Whereas** формальнее и чаще в письменном стиле.
> My brother loves jazz, **whereas** I prefer classical music. — Брат любит джаз, а я предпочитаю классику.
> **While** the first option is cheaper, the second is more reliable. — Хотя первый вариант дешевле, второй надёжнее.

## even though и even if
**Even though** — факт, который действительно имеет место: *I'm going, **even though** it's raining* (дождь идёт). **Even if** — гипотеза: *I'm going **even if** it rains* (пойду в любом случае, пойдёт ли дождь, ещё неизвестно).

## Книжные модели: Tired as he was, however hard
- **Прилагательное / наречие + as / though + подлежащее + глагол**: *Tired as she was, she finished the report.* — Как ни была она устала, отчёт закончила. Это формально, часто в литературе.
- **Much as**: *Much as I admire her, I disagree.* — Как бы я ни восхищался ею, я не согласен.
- **However + прилагательное / наречие**: *However hard I try, I can't remember it.* **Whatever, whoever, whichever** — «что бы / кто бы ни».
- Как самостоятельный линкер **however** стоит в начале нового предложения с запятой: *The plan failed. However, we learned a lot.*
en:
## although, though, even though: followed by a clause
All three mean 'in contrast to the fact that' and are followed by a **full clause**.
> **Although** the exam was difficult, most students passed.
> **Though** it was late, we decided to walk.
- **although** is neutral to formal; **though** is more informal; **even though** is stronger and stresses a surprising fact: *She smiled, **even though** she was in pain.*
- ~~Although he was ill, but he went to work.~~ → English does **not** use a second 'but': Although he was ill, he went to work.

## though at the end
Only **though** (not although) can go at the **end** of a sentence as an adverb meaning 'however':
> The flat is small. I like it, **though**.

## in spite of and despite: followed by a noun or -ing
**In spite of** and **despite** have the same meaning, but they are followed by a **noun, pronoun or -ing form**.
> **Despite** the traffic, we arrived on time.
> She kept working **in spite of** feeling exhausted.
To use a clause, add **the fact that**: *Despite **the fact that** he had no experience, he got the job.*
- ~~Despite of the delay~~ → **Despite** the delay
- ~~In spite the rain~~ → In spite **of** the rain
- ~~Despite he was tired~~ → Despite **being** tired / **the fact that** he was tired

## Contrast between two facts: while, whereas
**While** and **whereas** compare two facts. **Whereas** is more formal.
> My brother loves jazz, **whereas** I prefer classical music.
> **While** the first option is cheaper, the second is more reliable.

## even though and even if
**Even though** introduces a real fact: *I'm going, **even though** it's raining.* **Even if** introduces a possibility: *I'm going **even if** it rains.*

## Formal patterns: Tired as he was, however hard
- **adjective / adverb + as / though + subject + verb**: *Tired as she was, she finished the report.*
- **Much as**: *Much as I admire her, I disagree.*
- **However + adjective / adverb**: *However hard I try, I can't remember.* **Whatever, whoever, whichever** work in the same way.
- As a linking adverb, **however** starts a new sentence, followed by a comma: *The plan failed. However, we learned a lot.*
structure:
## Что стоит после слова
| Слово | После него | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| although / though / even though | подлежащее + глагол | Although it was late, we stayed. |
| in spite of / despite | существительное, -ing | Despite the delay, we stayed. |
| in spite of / despite the fact that | подлежащее + глагол | Despite the fact that it was late, we stayed. |
| while / whereas | подлежащее + глагол | Whereas Tom is shy, Ann is outgoing. |
| even if | гипотеза | I'll go even if it rains. |
| however (линкер) | запятая, новое предложение | It rained. However, we went. |

## Формулы
> **Adjective + as + subject + verb**, ...
> Young **as** she was, she led the team.

> **However + adj / adv + subject + verb**, ...
> **However** late it is, call me.

> **Much as** + subject + verb, ...
> **Much as** I'd like to help, I can't.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Although ..., but ...~~ → Although ..., ...
- ~~Despite of~~ → Despite / In spite of
- ~~Despite he was~~ → Despite being / Despite the fact that he was

exercises.title: Уступка: вставьте слово
exercises.instruction: Вставьте подходящее слово (если возможны варианты — достаточно одного).
exercises.example: ___ the rain, we went out. → **Despite** (In spite of)

items.text: {{Although|Though|Even though}} the exam was difficult, most students passed.
{{Despite|In spite of}} the traffic, we arrived on time.
She kept working {{despite|in spite of}} feeling exhausted.
He got the job, {{despite the fact that|in spite of the fact that|although|though|even though}} he had no experience.
Her sister is very outgoing, {{whereas|while}} she is rather shy.
I'll go for a run {{even if}} it rains tomorrow.
It's a modest flat. I like it, {{though}}.
{{Tired}} as she was, she finished the report.
{{However}} hard I try, I can't remember her name.
Much {{as}} I'd like to join you, I have a deadline tomorrow.
In {{spite}} of the warnings, they continued the climb.
She still refused, {{even though|although|though}} he had apologised twice.
The film was widely criticised, {{yet|but|and yet}} it won three awards.
{{While|Whereas|Although}} some people love city life, others prefer the countryside.
{{Despite|In spite of}} her age, she still runs marathons.

items.q: ___ the heavy rain, the concert went ahead.
items.why: Дальше существительное (the heavy rain) — нужен **despite**; although / even though требуют предложения.

items.q: ___ it was raining, they played outside.
She enjoyed the trip ___ the long journey.
I won't change my mind, ___ you offer me double.
items.why: Предложение ещё не сделано — гипотеза, поэтому **even if**; even though описывает реальный факт.

items.q: ___ as I admire her work, I disagree with this decision.
items.why: Устойчивая модель **Much as ...** — «как бы сильно ни».

items.q: ___ clever he is, he makes silly mistakes.
items.why: **However + прилагательное** = «каким бы ни был»; although с прилагательным напрямую не стоит.

items.q: He passed the exam, ___ he hadn't studied.
The ending was predictable. I enjoyed the book, ___.
items.why: В конце фразы со значением «впрочем» возможно только **though**.

exercises.title: Найдите верное предложение
exercises.instruction: Только одно предложение в каждом пункте правильное.

options: Although he was ill, but he went to work.
Although he was ill, he went to work.
Despite he was ill, he went to work.
items.why: С although второй союз «but» не нужен; despite не принимает предложение.

options: In spite the rain, we went out.
In spite of the rain, we went out.
Despite of the rain, we went out.
Despite being tired, she kept working.
Despite she was tired, she kept working.
In spite to be tired, she kept working.
I enjoyed the film, even though of its length.
I enjoyed the film, despite its length.
I enjoyed the film, although its length.
Strong as he is, he couldn't lift the piano.
Strong although he is, he couldn't lift the piano.
As strong he is, he couldn't lift the piano.

While the first option is cheaper, but the second is more reliable.
Despite the first option is cheaper, the second is more reliable.
items.why: С while «but» не нужен; despite не принимает предложение.

options: Even though she's a beginner, she plays beautifully.
Even she's a beginner, she plays beautifully.
Even despite she's a beginner, she plays beautifully.
items.why: Even не стоит один перед предложением — нужен even though / even if.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя союзы уступки.

items.prompt: Describe something you do even though you don't enjoy it (even though).
items.sample: I do the washing-up every evening even though I really dislike it.

items.prompt: Say what you would do despite a possible obstacle (despite / in spite of).
items.sample: I'd travel to Japan despite the high cost of the flight.

items.prompt: Compare yourself with a family member using whereas or while.
items.sample: My sister is very sporty, whereas I prefer reading at home.

items.prompt: Make a statement about something you like with 'though' at the end.
items.sample: My commute is long. I enjoy listening to podcasts, though.
